craft_notes: Sthāyin: north-facing burning. Rows: stand then burn. Read aloud: kindling.

lines: There liberation's lover, northward facing, stand,
that by the Lord's fell-fire splendour, swift indeed,
his bands burnt off, he free remain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra mumukṣur uttarābhimukhas tiṣṭhet yathā bhagavadaghoratejasā jhaṭity eva pruṣṭapāśo bhavet
